rules.description: Applicants must submit a copy of their Aadhaar enrolment request.
rules.condition: When applying for the scholarship as specified in sub‑paragraph (b) of paragraph 2.
rules.outcome: A copy of the Aadhaar enrolment request must be provided.
rules.evidence_quote: a copy of her or his request made for Aadhaar enrolment, as specified in sub‑paragraph (b) of paragraph 2;

rules.description: Applicants must provide one of the specified identity documents.
rules.condition: When submitting identity proof for the scholarship application.
rules.outcome: One of the following documents must be submitted: Bank passbook with photograph; Ration Card; Permanent Account Number (PAN) Card issued by the Income Tax Department; Passport; Certificate of identity having photo of such student issued by a Headmaster or Principal of School under official seal of the school; Driving license issued by the Licensing Authority under the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 (59 of 1988); or any other documents specified by the State Government or Union territory Administration.
rules.evidence_quote: (i) Bank passbook with photograph; or (ii) Ration Card, or (iii) Permanent Account Number (PAN) Card issued by the Income Tax Department; or (iv) Passport; or (v) Certificate of identity having photo of such student issued by a Headmaster or Principal of School under official seal of the school; or (vi) Driving license issued by the Licensing Authority under the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 (59 of 1988); or (vii) any other documents specified by the State Government or Union territory Administration.

rules.description: For applicants from Assam, Jammu & Kashmir, and Meghalaya, only the listed identity documents are required.
rules.condition: If the applicant resides in Assam, Jammu & Kashmir, or Meghalaya.
rules.outcome: Only the documents mentioned in para (b)(i) to (vii) shall be required.
rules.evidence_quote: [Note- For Assam, Jammu & Kashmir and Meghalaya, the documents mentioned at para (b) (i) to (vii) shall only be required]
